items.name: Quality
items.desc: Sets the options below at once. Auto turns quality down by itself if the game runs slowly.

items.name: Render resolution
items.desc: Lower draws fewer pixels and scales the picture up: much faster, a little softer.

items.name: Ambient occlusion
items.desc: Soft shade in corners and under things.

items.name: Bloom
items.desc: Lamps, lit windows and the bright sky glow softly.

items.name: Reflections and bounce light
items.desc: Shiny floors reflect the room; light bounces off walls.

items.name: Volumetric haze
items.desc: Sunlight catches in the air between the buildings.

items.name: View distance
items.desc: How far you see before the city fades into the smog.

items.name: Film colour grade
items.desc: The washed-out, warm, gritty look. Off shows plain colours.

items.name: V-Sync
items.desc: Waits for the screen, so the picture never tears.

items.name: Passers-by
items.desc: Fewer keeps the workers and the people with jobs, but sends half the walkers home.

items.name: Field of view
items.desc: How wide you see. Fights are 6° narrower, as you aim down the gun.

items.name: Key hints
items.desc: The line of controls along the bottom.

hi: You. Yeah, you. Got a minute?
Don't just stand there.

Make it quick, I'm busy.
